approvalNote: Reviewed side by side against ref.png at full size, plus the composition and overflow gates. Structure, hierarchy, reading order and every departure from the source confirmed against the template's own header notes. This is a MACHINE approval: no human has read these against the bank. Treat it as a gate that has been honestly passed, not as sign-off by the deck owner. CAVEAT: The source's bespoke infographic is NOT reproduced — the slot carries a motif. What is traced is the annotation pattern.

regions.note: Screenshot, diagram or motif. Inlined at fill time (§2a).

invariants: Callouts are PLACED near what they describe, not listed down a side. A callout that is not near its subject is a caption, and a caption is what this template exists to avoid.
The ordinals carry reading order, because position cannot.
Three to five callouts. Two does not need this template; six turns the slide into a diagram of its own annotations.
The media slot never carries bespoke artwork as a requirement. The source's infographic does not generalise and the template does not pretend to hold it.
